view.name: Manage sources
view.description: Source settings list with Add source / OPML import links, export link, and each subscribed feed with Edit, More actions and last-post info; a failing feed is outlined in red.

regions.label: Dark nav sidebar: logo, Mark as read, collapsible Filter/Tags/Sources sections, refresh and settings buttons at bottom
Add source, import OPML and Export sources links
Alphabetical list of 22 feed sources, each with favicon, title, Edit and More actions links and last post seen; first row outlined red (error)

evidence.note: Persistent dark left sidebar with filter destinations, tags, sources, refresh and settings buttons
FILTER and TAGS expanded, SOURCES collapsed with triangle indicator; clicking Sources on live page expanded the source list independently
Live: opens small dropdown with Browse and Delete
Live: Edit expands the row in place into Title/Tags/Filter/Type/URL fields with Save • Cancel

patterns.rationale: Source edit form only appears after clicking Edit / Add source; not visible in capture

evidence.note: Settings link leads here but content is a CRUD list of feed sources, not a catalog of options
Unread counts per source exist only inside collapsed Sources section; not visible in capture
Rows are plain list items on light strip backgrounds, not cards

structure.layout: app layout with fixed dark left sidebar (filters, tags, sources accordions, bottom refresh/settings buttons), a floating search toggle, and a single-column list of feed sources in the main area

aesthetics.typography: Open Sans throughout: 16px regular for source titles and sidebar nav, 13px for row metadata/actions, 13px bold uppercase small caps for sidebar section headers, 11px for OPML/export links; Arial in inputs
aesthetics.typeScale: Very flat: 16px titles vs 13px grey meta vs 11px links; hierarchy by color (#333 vs #aaa) rather than size or weight

notes: selfoss RSS reader admin view. Main area has a faint diagonal hatch texture; each source row is a full-width very-light-grey strip with a colored square favicon/monogram, title, and grey inline text-link actions separated by bullets ('Edit • More actions • Last post seen yesterday'). Errored source (Tin Can Podcast) gets a thin red outline and no favicon/last-seen. Dark charcoal sidebar with teal vertical edge stripe, mascot logo, disabled grey 'Mark as read' button, and two square icon buttons (refresh, cloud/settings) pinned at bottom. Search is a collapsed magnifier tab floating beside sidebar.
